description: Offline interactive Business Economics explorer for second-semester B.Com. LL.B. students: demand and supply, elasticity, consumer behaviour, production and costs, market structures, factor pricing and macroeconomics – with live graphs, calculators, a pricing game, animations, formula sheet, flashcards, quiz and certificate.
changes: 1.0.0 - first release: 6 units, live supply-demand graph with price controls, elasticity calculator, utility maximiser, cost-curve and shut-down lab, prisoner's dilemma pricing game, law of variable proportions and circular flow animations, 10 labs, formula sheet, 35 flashcards, 30-question quiz, references, progress bar and certificate
status: Complete for Semester II reference syllabus; replace unit details when TNNLU's official course outline is issued
